name: Sanctions Screening Agent
description: Screens a counterparty (person or entity) against the bank's sanctions lists and returns a match decision with evidence. Owned by the Sanctions team. Synthetic example.

oauth2SecurityScheme.description: OAuth 2.0 client credentials: one client per calling agent

skills.name: Screen counterparty
skills.description: Checks a person or entity name against sanctions lists. Asks for more identifiers (e.g. date of birth) when the name is ambiguous.
examples: Is Orbit Trading Ltd on any sanctions list?
Screen Maria Fictitia, born 1980-04-12, before we onboard her as a beneficiary
